description: This Python source file defines a configuration class for Vertex AI Gemini image generation within a larger SDK or framework. It includes methods for handling parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation for the Gemini API, and response transformation to the internal format. The class facilitates integration with Vertex AI’s Gemini models specifically for image generation tasks.
